notes.title: HD Release!
notes.notes:
Supporting up to 1920x1080 resolutions, Sorcery Jokers will be a fully HD compatible release - our very first at MangaGamer!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31404500/4ba64ce90ae37ba9a955fd0a083067738c8b5978.jpg

If you're looking for some other great visual novels, both new and old, take a look at our entire collection.

notes.notes:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/703730/Sorcery_Jokers_All_Ages_Version/
